quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on advice from Shaquille O'Neal to play bigger
quotes.excerpt: He was just telling me to play bigger than what I am.
quotes.quote: I did get to talk to Shaquille O'Neal a couple weeks ago when he was here. He was just telling me to play bigger than what I am. Just grab every rebound, push in transition, and offensive rebound, and I have been taking his word and doing that ever since.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says he has been playing with more intensity after receiving advice from Shaquille O Neal to play bigger and focus on grabbing every rebound

structured.context: Miles Bridges discusses advice he received from Shaquille O'Neal regarding his playstyle.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the need for better rebounding from the team
quotes.excerpt: The only thing with us is we have got to do a better job of rebounding.
quotes.quote: The only thing with us is we have got to do a better job of rebounding. Stop giving teams second chances, because I feel like our half-court defense is pretty good. It is just when teams get rebounds and kick-outs, that is when we get in trouble. So, once we start rebounding, I think our defense will pick up.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges identifies rebounding as the primary issue for the Suns defense saying that stopping second chance opportunities is the key to their success

structured.context: Miles Bridges explains the team's need to improve rebounding to strengthen their defensive performance.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on adjusting to the Phoenix Suns' defensive system
quotes.excerpt: Here at Phoenix, we want to turn the ball over.
quotes.quote: Just getting used to the system. Like I said before, with Charlotte, we were playing defense where we would not want a team to get downhill or get a good shot up. Here at Phoenix, we want to turn the ball over. So, you know, I have been more aggressive with that and trying to just get steals and get blocks.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges explains his defensive adjustment in Phoenix noting that the team prioritizes forcing turnovers compared to his previous role in Charlotte

structured.context: Miles Bridges describes the differences between the defensive systems in Phoenix and Charlotte.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on building chemistry with Kevin Durant and the team
quotes.excerpt: Being able to shoot with one of the best three-point shooters in the league is helping me.
quotes.quote: Just need shooting with Kevin Durant. Being able to shoot with one of the best three-point shooters in the league is definitely been helping me in my confidence. My teammates have confidence in me shooting the ball. Every time I pass it for a shot, they tell me to shoot it. So, credit to my teammates and my coaches.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges credits his teammates and Kevin Durant for boosting his confidence as a shooter saying they encourage him to take his shots whenever he is open

structured.context: Miles Bridges discusses his confidence and chemistry while playing alongside Kevin Durant.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on the importance of off-ball movement
quotes.excerpt: The best players are the ones that move around all the time.
quotes.quote: The best players are the ones that move around all the time. There is only a few players that just iso their whole career, James Harden, Luka Doncic, those type of guys. You have to have a special talent for that. For me, I have to get mine off the rebound, cut to the basket, transition, and get stops. So, that is just my game.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges says he is not a pure isolation scorer like James Harden or Luka Doncic and instead focuses on cutting and transition play to be effective

structured.context: Miles Bridges explains his personal approach to off-ball movement compared to isolation-heavy players.
